scenario: Batch create rulesets across two repos from the spreadsheet textarea
preconditions: Requester has admin on both repos
form_inputs: org, rulesets_csv with 2+ rows (repository,ruleset_name,target,ref_name_pattern,enforcement,require_pull_request,block_force_pushes,require_linear_history,restrict_deletions), approver, dry_run=true
expected_result: Status awaiting_approval; per-row plan to create each ruleset; no mutation

scenario: Creating an existing ruleset name is a no-op
preconditions: Requester admin; a ruleset of that name already exists on the repo
expected_result: No-op for the existing row; no duplicate ruleset

scenario: A row for a repo the requester does not admin is rejected while other rows pass
preconditions: Requester admin on repo A but not repo B; repo B not in requester's repo-admin team
form_inputs: rows for repo A and repo B
expected_result: Repo A row create; repo B row rejected (unauthorized); other rows unaffected

scenario: Tenant repo-admin team member authorizes a tenant repo without direct repo admin
preconditions: Repo resolves to a tenant in the registry; requester is an active member of that tenant X_RepoAdmin team

scenario: Imported repo not in the tenant model works for a repo admin
preconditions: Repo is not in any tenant record; requester has admin on it
form_inputs: single-item fields or a CSV row for the imported repo
expected_result: Row authorized via repository_admin path; ruleset created

scenario: Live batch create against real repositories
form_inputs: valid rows, dry_run=false, approver posts approved
expected_result: Rulesets created per row; per-row audit records applied/skipped/failed
